summary: 71-year-old Cortez man George day-hiking with his neighbor's dog from a car parked on Taylor Mesa fell and hit his head, was unconscious for hours, then walked 16 miles in the wrong direction; multi-day search by Dolores County SAR with dog teams, a CO National Guard Lakota helicopter, and an AFRCC PLB notification; found Friday in the rugged Stoner Creek Drainage and flown by the Lakota to the command post, then hospitalized; the dog was found two miles from the car.
location: Taylor Mesa / Stoner Creek Drainage (Cortez area)
responding_agency: Dolores County Search and Rescue; San Miguel County SAR; Colorado National Guard; AFRCC; CSAR state coordinators
notes: Date approximate: the CSAR account says only 'Tuesday morning in August, 2015' (2015-08-04 was a Tuesday; first-of-month convention); the search ran Tuesday-Friday, he was found Friday, and he recovered in hospital for three weeks. The deaf neighbor's dog was also located; victim count counts the hiker only.
